tools.name: list_rankings
tools.description: List every published Top 11 ranking (slug, title, last-verified date).

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Return the full structured ranking for one Top 11 list by slug, including all 11 entries with scores, verdicts, pros/cons, and pricing.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: Return a single ranked entry from a Top 11 list by slug and rank (1-11).

tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Hand over a user's situation and get the best-matched picks from a Top 11 list. Describe the problem in plain language (e.g. 'startup that needs to get fundraise-ready' or 'reduce no-shows for a dental practice'); optionally add a persona/segment, a budget band ($, $$, $$$), and a max_risk ceiling t

tools.name: pick_one
tools.description: Which one should I pick? Hand-researched verdicts on the top three of a Top 11 list, with a named winner per buyer type, a side-by-side table and the vendor URL behind every price (prices read on each vendor's own site). Call with no slug to get every verdict; pass a list slug (e.g. 'tms-for-freight

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two ranked providers by brand name. Returns rank, score, pricing, verdict, pros, cons for each, plus a one-line winner call.

tools.name: cheapest
tools.description: Return the cheapest providers in one Top 11 list, sorted by lowest published starting price first. Optional max_price filter.

tools.name: best_for
tools.description: Return Top 11 providers best suited to a segment/persona/use-case in one list. Use this for 'best CRM for dentists', 'best fractional CFO for AI startups', etc.

tools.name: compliant
tools.description: Return Top 11 providers holding a specific compliance certification (SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO27001, FedRAMP, PCI).

tools.name: works_with
tools.description: Return Top 11 providers that integrate with a named third-party tool (e.g. QuickBooks, NetSuite, Salesforce, Open Dental).

tools.name: in_region
tools.description: Return Top 11 providers serving a region (US, UK, EU, Canada, Global).

tools.name: fastest
tools.description: Return Top 11 providers sorted by quickest onboarding time (days from contract to live).

tools.name: free_tier
tools.description: Return Top 11 providers that offer a free tier (not a free trial).

tools.name: recommend_across_lists
tools.description: Cross-list recommendation: pulls candidates from every published Top 11 list, ranked by relevance to the problem. Use when the user's problem could span multiple categories.
